patch.summary:
Choose AdCreative.ai only if your buying job matches “AI ad creative generator for paid media — Starter $29/mo; higher tiers for more credits an” rather than Midjourney's shape. Choose Midjourney only if your buying job matches “AI image (and video) generation — no free plan; Basic $10/mo ($8 annual); Standard $30; Pr” rather than AdCreative.ai's shape. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.
